text:
mila: Quick PSA — there's a lone scone in the kitchen. Looks heroic and buttery. :tada:
omar: I saw that one. I put a post-it 'RESERVED' but it's gone now.
jisoo: Not me. I brought bagels earlier. 
ben: I'm 98% certain I heard it whisper my name.
mila: Alright poll: emoji react to claim it — :raising_hand: = it's mine, :eyes: = I am watching, :no_entry_sign: = hands off
jisoo: Voting :eyes:
omar: :raising_hand: — guilty as charged, but will share
coffee-bot: (automated) Free drip for whoever brings napkins to accompany the scone. :coffee:
mila: Deal. omar bring napkins and the team will provide applause (and coffee)
ben: Also, tiny crumb trail on the floor — forensic snack analysis commencing :mag:
omar: lol crumb trail leads to my desk, but it's a decoy.
jisoo: Please no undercover pastry agents. :laughing:
mila: Photo for posterity: https://imgur.com/a/ExampleScone
ben: 2 questions: is it savory? and is it vegan?
omar: savory? no. vegan? also no. pure butter happiness :butter:
jisoo: I'm coming to the kitchen in 2 — if it's still there it's fate
mila: First one to bring napkins gets bragging rights for the week. :crown:
